348:t_009:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The farce is over. ...I only came to see your faces, but I've changed my mind.」

348:t_009:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll fight you for just three minutes!」

348:t_009:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Fine by me, $$バルビエル$$. I've got plenty to pay you back for.」

348:t_009:3.en:
$n
「I'll beat you in those three minutes...!」

348:t_009:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come on, $$いがみ合う双子$$...! I'll drown you in a sea of your own hatred!」

348:t_010:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... I'll finish you here!」

348:t_011:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're too slow, you idiot!」

348:t_012:0.en:
$n
「He crossed that distance in an instant...!」

348:t_012:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Once you reach the Third Stage, you can do tricks like this, too.」

348:t_012:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$F. It was a mistake to expect anything from you in the first place.」

348:t_012:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'd rather reset things here than let them have your $$スフィア$$!」

348:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hahaha! Curse your own fate!」

348:t_014:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We'll discuss that later, $$クロウ$$. We must defeat $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ here.」

348:t_014:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I followed him all the way to $$火星$$, but this was an unexpected find.」

348:t_014:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then let us call the man you're after, too.」

348:t_015:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「There's no need to worry. His target now is $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$.」

348:t_015:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So my $$スフィア$$ and $n's are off the menu for now.」

348:t_015:6.en:
$$桂$$
「$$アサキム$$ teamed up with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!?」

348:t_015:7.en:
$$モーム$$
「Could the one who freed him from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ have been...」

348:t_015:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Was it you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

348:t_015:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Come, $n... Let us fight together again.」

348:t_015:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You can't trust me, can you? ...I can hardly blame you.」

348:t_015:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...You're wide open, $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

348:t_016:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch! Someone's getting in my way again!?」

348:t_017:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world and its people, $$ダイターン３$$ crushes evil's ambitions!」

348:t_017:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you do not fear the radiance of this sun, come at me!」

348:t_018:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The sun... is it?」

348:t_018:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I told you, $$バルビエル$$. Now that I've defeated the $$メガノイド$$s, I'll devote all my strength to fighting $$サイデリアル$$.」

348:t_018:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you were the one who defeated those $$メガノイド$$s, $$万丈$$!」

348:t_018:4.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$勝平$$ told us you were off on your own, but I had no idea you were doing that!」

348:t_018:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry it took so long to join you. But I wanted to settle things with them myself.」

348:t_018:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's all right. All that matters is that you're here.」

348:t_018:7.en:
$$桂$$
「And your timing couldn't be better. You give me chills every time...!」

348:t_018:8.en:
$n
「So that's... the dashing hero, $$破嵐万丈$$.」

348:t_018:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「As you can see, he's a cheerful tough guy with the sun at his back.」

348:t_019:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「We just met, but could I ask you to back me up?」

348:t_019:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「I don't know what happened, but a shock that leaves you frozen on the battlefield doesn't fade so easily.」

348:t_020:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... Shall we start afresh?」

348:t_021:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This is getting interesting. That's what $$火星$$ is all about!」

348:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c. $$アサキム$$ and I will support you.」

348:t_022:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Can we trust you, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

348:t_022:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Whatever we may think of you, we cannot trust $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

348:t_022:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then trust me. I have no intention of lying.」

348:t_022:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Defeating $$バルビエル$$ comes first. But all units, remain on guard.」

348:t_022:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「In the end, you're no different from me. You bear the $$烙印$$...」

348:t_022:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So it comes back to that...」

348:t_022:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry, I don't have time for your poetry. First, I'll pay $$バルビエル$$ back...!」
